cookie.title: Cookie Shield
cookie.subtitle: Manage and block third-party cross-site tracking cookies to protect your digital identity.

cookie.info_name_val_desc: Identifier name and stored data string value (like Login token, Session ID).
cookie.info_domain_path_desc: Determines the scope of websites that have access to this cookie. Default path is `/` (entire site).
cookie.info_expiry_desc: Cookie lifetime as a Unix Timestamp (seconds since 1970).
cookie.info_samesite_desc: Controls cross-site cookie transmission: None (always send), Lax (only on safe navigations), Strict (same-site only).
cookie.info_secure_desc: When enabled, the cookie is only transmitted over the encrypted HTTPS protocol.
cookie.info_httponly_desc: When enabled, prevents JavaScript from accessing this cookie (helps prevent token theft via XSS).
cookie.info_session_desc: Temporary cookie, automatically deleted when you completely close the browser.
cookie.import_desc: Paste cookie data or choose an upload file (select only 1 JSON or TXT file).
cookie.format_json_desc: An array of objects containing cookie properties (name, value, domain, etc.). Usually exported from tools like Cookie-Editor.
cookie.format_header_desc: Text string of `name=value` pairs separated by semicolons (;). Retrieved from `Cookie` network request header.
cookie.format_netscape_desc: Tab-separated values text format (.txt) traditionally used by Netscape/Mozilla.
cookie.export_encrypt_desc: Protect your cookies with a password

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to KiGuard Security & Privacy. Before continuing to use the extension, please read and accept the following terms of use:
terms.point_1_desc: KiGuard is committed to maximizing your data protection, and does not collect or share your browsing history or cookies externally.
terms.point_2_desc: Any action to edit, add, or delete cookies should be done carefully. You are solely responsible for the security of your personal cookies.
terms.point_3_desc: Features like anti-tracking and ad-blocking operate automatically locally to deliver a safe browsing experience.
terms.outro: By clicking "Accept & Continue", you agree to comply with KiGuard's privacy terms.
proxy.webrtc_desc: Prevent leaking your real machine IP address via WebRTC protocol while using a Proxy.
proxy.webrtc_hide_ip: Hide real IP (Only use Proxy IP for WebRTC)
proxy.gps_desc: Spoof browser GPS coordinates to hide your actual physical location.
proxy.timezone_desc: Override browser JavaScript timezone to match the active Proxy IP region to bypass timezone filters.
proxy.autoreload_desc: Automatically reload all open web pages after connecting to a proxy to apply the new IP immediately.
proxy.ua_desc: Change browser and OS identity information sent to websites.
proxy.conflict_desc: Scan and disable other extensions with proxy permissions to avoid configuration conflicts.
